text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I-It's amazing!!!! How are you catching 
them one after another like that?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You should be prouder too, Trainer! This 
is an extraordinary talent!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, let's take a commemorative photo! I'd 
love to show it to the kids back at my 
hometown club."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Just how amazing my Trainer really is!
